I am a Research Professional at the Booth School of Business at the University of Chicago, working with Christina Patterson and Joe Vavra. I received my BA in Economics from Boston University in May 2025, with minors in Mathematics and Innovation & Entrepreneurship. My email is zifan.huang@chicagobooth.edu.
